findings.message: No regression test was added for the issue's cases. The fix is correct, but the only test (`test_simple`) does not cover the reported bug, so a future regression of the strip logic would go undetected.
findings.suggestion: Add assertions such as `slugify("  Hello,  World!  ") == "hello-world"` and `slugify("a -- b") == "a-b"` (plus an all-separator case like `slugify("---") == ""`) to lock in the behavior.
